src: HOWDY, FRIENDS! ENJOYIN' MY BEAUTIFUL SWAMP?
speaker: BILLY

src: EVERYTHING THAT DOESN'T SINK INTO THE MUD, THAT IS! HA HA HA...
speaker: BILLY

src: JUDGING BY THE SMELL, I'D WAGER YOUR
speaker: DAXTER

src: BATHTUB SANK IN THE MUD LONG AGO.
speaker: DAXTER

src: ANYWAY I GOT BIGGER PROBLEMS NOW...
speaker: BILLY

src: SEEMS SOME NASTY LURKER VARMINTS ARE GROUSIN' ABOUTS,
speaker: BILLY

src: SNATCHIN' EVERYTHING THEY CAN GET THEIR GRUBBY LITTLE PAWS ON.
speaker: BILLY

src: AND SCARIN' AWAY MY PET HIPHOG, FARTHY.
speaker: BILLY

src: HE'S BEEN MISSIN' FOR NIGH ON TO A COON'S AGE.
speaker: BILLY

src: I'VE BEEN PUTTIN' OUT HIS FAVORITE SNACK,
speaker: BILLY

src: BUT THOSE ORNERY SWAMP RATS KEEP STEALIN' EM!
speaker: BILLY

src: IF YOU COULD KEEP THOSE PESKY CRITTERS AWAY LONG ENOUGH,
speaker: BILLY

src: I JUST KNOW FARTHY WOULD SMELL THEM VITTLES AND COME BACK!
speaker: BILLY
